findings.message: In a stub file an import is only treated as a public re-export if it uses the redundant `X as X` form, which every other import in this .pyi does. As written, type checkers will flag `airflow.sdk.AsyncCallback` / `SyncCallback` (and `DeadlineAlert` / `DeadlineReference` on the deadline import below) as private even though they are listed in `__all__`.

A blocking `time.sleep(60)` in an example DAG occupies a worker slot for a full minute whenever the example DAGs are executed in CI. Consider shortening the deadline interval and the sleep so the alert still fires but the example finishes quickly.
